messages.text:
PhysVal-01 examined commit `1dff0452ed1e7ac24d7b746fccc02ee15df5258d`. No files changed; no native simulation executed.

The proposed **geometric digitization with consistent pitch²/12 covariance** is suitable for an explicitly **ideal binary pitch-sensitivity study**. Independent per-pitch calibration is required for stronger calibrated-response claims, but is not essential for measuring fitted residual distributions under this stated model.

Required controls:

- Change only systems 4/5 local-v pitch: **0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 mm**. Local-v means barrel z and endcap radial; retain fine 75 µm pitch.
- Use fresh PR104 balanced geometry/material identities. Existing truth-tracking campaign identifies PR100; `tracker_reconstruction/prepare.py:25–50` supplies the maintained geometry and role-remapped material.
- Ensure positions and covariance both reflect the new segmentation. No unchanged fine measurements with merely enlarged uncertainty.
- Match generated truth and preferably primary sim-hit sequences event by event across pitches. Common seeds alone do not prove pairing.
- Keep all generated events in efficiency denominators, retain unsuccessful fits, and distinguish fit success from native truth-matched efficiency.
- Report central 68.27% residual half-width, biases, uncut SD/RMS, pull diagnostics, wrong-charge fraction and attrition versus eta and pT.
- Compute ratios/differences using paired event bootstrap. Include a common-success control to expose survivor bias.
- Keep geometry crossings invariant. Retain cluster-size/local residual diagnostics because geometric cluster centroids need not follow a single-cell uniform distribution.
- State that perfect truth association/seeding excludes pattern-recognition and occupancy performance. Pulls remain diagnostics of the assumed uncalibrated covariance model.

Analytical controls, not track-resolution predictions:

| Local-v pitch | Ideal single-cell σv | Total strixel channels |
|---|---:|---:|
| 0.5 mm | 144.34 µm | 1,521,745,920 |
| 1 mm | 288.68 µm | 760,872,960 |
| 1.5 mm | 433.01 µm | 507,248,640 |
| 2 mm | 577.35 µm | 380,436,480 |

Fine-coordinate σu stays 21.65 µm. Track resolution must be measured; proportional degradation cannot be inferred from these values. Channel reductions of 50%, 66.67% and 75% do not establish equal service-space or power reductions.

Evidence: `docs/design/DES-007-short-strip-modules.md:60–82,119`; `software/analysis/truth_tracking/digitization.py:20–63`; `runtime.py:87–111`; `metrics.py:38–153`; `smearing.py:11–19,71–101`. Ready for the separately pinned implementation/results review.
